preconditions.description: Attacker must have some balance of the token being swapped in the D_Swap contract
The D_Swap contract must have sufficient liquidity of the target token for the swap

exploit_hint: The Impl_Delivery() function violates checks-effects-interactions pattern by making external calls before updating state. Create a malicious contract that calls back into the vulnerable function during the token transfer to drain funds. The attack should involve: 1) Deploy attack contract with reentrancy callback, 2) Initiate swap via Impl_Delivery(), 3) During token transfer to attacker, re-enter the function to execute multiple swaps before balances are updated, 4) Withdraw stolen funds.
